verdicts.claim: Every guild of at most twelve standing members holds exactly the keys whose highest clean-numbered statement is a join (a number signed two different ways is clean for neither), in the order of their keys, and refuses every attack with its reason; every guild with more than twelve standing is refused, saying how many stand.
verdicts.saw: 379 of 379 guilds stood exactly as the keys signed, every one of their 1895 attacks refused with its reason; 21 of 21 guilds past twelve were refused

verdicts.claim: Every guild is the very same in three orders of its statements.
verdicts.saw: 379 of 379 guilds were the very same in three orders of their statements

verdicts.claim: Every member’s estate in every guild draws to exactly the picture of the estate it signed; every honest member’s drop cards match the drop; and every member who signed a drop card with a wrong department is caught by the drop.
verdicts.saw: 379 of 379 guilds drew every member’s estate exactly as it signed it; 379 had every honest member’s drop cards match the drop; 274 of 274 members who signed a drop card wrongly were caught by the drop

verdicts.claim: A guild of twelve members is read, every signature checked, in a median under 2,000 ms on the machine that measures it.
verdicts.saw: a guild of twelve was read in a median 16 ms (24 guilds of twelve timed)

verdicts.claim: A member with twenty drop cards signs a join whose code, as a player copies it, is under 6,000 characters.
verdicts.saw: a member with twenty drop cards signs a code of at most 3512 characters (20 codes)
